verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule reaches a maximum speed of approximately 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) during its reentry into Earth's atmosphere.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Artemis II reentry speed estimated at 25,000 mph'; R3: 'speeds in excess of 25,000 miles per hour'; R6: 'maximum velocity of about 25,000 mph when it reenters'; R7: '40,000 kilometers per hour (25,000 miles per hour)'; R1: 'approximately 23,864 mph — just before entry interface' (close approximation); R4: 'peak velocity of 24,664 miles per hour'; R5: '24,661.21 mph'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or estimate reentry speed at ~25,000 mph; precise values slightly lower but claim uses 'approximately' matching common estimates.

verifications.claim: Artemis 2 maximum velocity is reached just before entry interface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Orion will reach its maximum velocity — approximately 23,864 mph — just before entry interface.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states maximum velocity just before entry interface.

verifications.claim: Artemis 2 Trans-Lunar Injection speed is ~24,527 mph (39,472 km/h).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R8: 'the spacecraft traveled at 39,472 kilometers (24,527 miles) per hour.'
verifications.reasoning: R8 exactly matches the TLI speed cited.

verifications.claim: Artemis 2 parachute deployment slows capsule to ~300 mph, then 17 mph for landing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'two drogue parachutes... to about 307 miles per hour... slow Orion down to approximately 17 mph'; R7: 'Two drogue parachutes slow Orion to roughly 480 kilometers per hour (300 miles per hour)... to 27 kilometers per hour (17 miles per hour)'; R5: 'slow the Orion crew capsule down from about 300 mph to... less than 20 mph'; R2: 'slow them down to 17 mph'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm drogue parachutes slow to ~300 mph, main parachutes to ~17 mph.

verifications.claim: Artemis 2 mid-space cruise speed is ~17,000 mph.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Artemis II cruised through outer space at about 17,000 miles per hour'; R6: 'the Artemis II SLS rocket hit more than 17,000 mph' (context of spaceflight speeds)
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states cruise speed at ~17,000 mph during spaceflight.
